subject: [PATCH RFC v4 11/12] mm/gup: batch contiguous PTE-mapped large folios in follow_page_mask()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Questioned whether this patch belongs in the current series, suggesting it would fit better with another optimization to take one refcount per continuously mapped extent of pages from the same folio.

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Agreed to drop the patch for now, suggesting it would be better suited for a follow-up and could be combined with another optimization.

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of PTE-mapped large folios in follow_page_mask() by batching contiguous pages together, reducing the number of page table walks required for these mappings. The optimization is based on the observation that huge PMD and PUD paths already return the whole mapping in one step, and applies a similar approach to the PTE case. The patch also ensures that per-PTE guarantees are maintained for the head page.
